investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All Available Nodes
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-06-30T10:04–10:12Z because the Kubernetes scheduler could not place the agent pod: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. The pod remained Unschedulable for 134–146 seconds across all three checks, preventing any VM from being assigned and causing every required evidence field (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) to go uncollected.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0 of 6 nodes able to schedule the pod and preemption offering no relief, no remote agent VM can be provisioned. This is a production infrastructure capacity constraint, not an eval runner or source-code defect. The eval failure is a direct and accurate reflection of the underlying scheduling failure.

investigations.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in production-api at 2026-06-30T10:04–10:12Z because the Kubernetes scheduler could not place the agent pod: 2 of 6 nodes reported Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity and the remaining 4 nodes did not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agent swarm has exhausted its allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that match the pod's node affinity/selector. With 0 of 6 nodes able to schedule the pod and preemption offering no relief, no remote agent VM can be provisioned. This is a production infrastructure capacity constraint, not an eval runner or source-code defect. The eval failure is a direct and accurate reflection of the underlying scheduling failure.

investigations.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the remote-agents feature has exhausted the allocatable kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 nodes that carry that resource class. The remaining 4 nodes are excluded by the pod's node affinity/selector rules. With no schedulable node and no preemption victims available, every new remote-agent pod is stuck in Unschedulable state indefinitely. The eval probe (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs, remote-agent-state branch at line 1900–1905) depends on createAgent succeeding before it can poll state and emit the required evidence; because the pod never scheduled, no evidence was produced and the expected-output contract (infra/evals/status/check-expectations.json line 264) was violated in full.
